items.source: Branches to the specified label if the top two items on the stack are not equal. The items must both be of the specified class. Equality is determined by comparing primitive values directly and by invoking the equals method for Objects. Arrays are recursively processed in the same manner.
items.translation: 如果栈顶的两个项目不相等，则跳转到指定的标签。这两个项目必须都是指定类型。相等性通过直接比较基本值以及为对象调用 `equals` 方法来确定。数组以相同的方式递归处理。

items.source:
Process an array on the stack. Assumes the top item on the stack
is an array of the specified type. For each element in the array,
puts the element on the stack and triggers the callback.
items.translation: 在栈上处理数组。假设栈顶元素是指定类型的数组。对于数组中的每个元素，将该元素压入栈中并触发回调。

items.source:
Process two arrays on the stack in parallel. Assumes the top two items on the stack
are arrays of the specified class. The arrays must be the same length. For each pair
of elements in the arrays, puts the pair on the stack and triggers the callback.
items.translation: 在栈上并行处理两个数组。假设栈顶的两个项目是指定类的数组。这两个数组必须具有相同的长度。对于数组中的每对元素，将这对元素放入栈中并触发回调。

items.source: type - the type of the array (type.isArray() must be true)
items.translation: type - 数组的类型（必须满足 type.isArray()）

items.source: callback - the callback triggered for each element
items.translation: callback - 为每个元素触发的回调

items.source: type - the type of the arrays (type.isArray() must be true)
items.translation: type - 数组的类型（必须满足 type.isArray()）

items.source: callback - the callback triggered for each pair of elements
items.translation: callback - 为每对元素触发的回调

items.source:
Branches to the specified label if the top two items on the stack
are not equal.
items.translation: 如果栈顶的两个项目不相等，则分支到指定的标签。

Process two arrays on the stack in parallel.
items.translation: 在栈上并行处理两个数组。
